rows.answer: The build fails because the function `sandbox::checksum` is declared in `include/sandbox/ring_buffer.hpp` at line 31 but has no implementation. The test file `tests/test_ring_buffer.cpp` at line 25 calls this function, causing a linker error. The implementation is missing from the source code.

The ring_buffer test fails because the `full()` function in src/ring_buffer.cpp line 29 has incorrect logic. It returns true when `count_ + 1 == slots_.size()` instead of `count_ == slots_.size()`. This causes the buffer to be incorrectly considered full when it still has one available slot, preventing the third push from succeeding. The test expects to push 3 elements into a buffer of capacity 3, but the logic prevents this due to the faulty full() check.

history.name: propose_patch

arguments.find: bool RingBuffer::full() const { return count_ + 1 == slots_.size(); }
arguments.replace: bool RingBuffer::full() const { return count_ == slots_.size(); }
arguments.rationale: The full() method was incorrectly checking if count_ + 1 equals the size, which would make a buffer appear full one element early. It should check if count_ equals the size to properly detect when the buffer is full.

The test times out because the loop never terminates.
